details:
Vrchats actual Text 'Chat' functionality is archaic and over simplistic and basically a platitude left behind from the implementation of EAC. It is basically the definition of 'bare minimum product' and basically there to satisfy the handful of users that were pretending to be offended. Sorry not sorry for the callout. 

Legitimately every social space that does this, does it better, the inclusion of VR is not an excuse to slack on it's implementation. There are only positives that can come from users being able to pay better attention to the disabled and those that abuse this extended functionality can easily be moderated. 

1. Chat legibility shouldn't be avatar/world dependent in any form. There are too many situations where chat is hidden in avatars' hair, or in world's ceilings or in rare cases even hidden by post processing and particle effects. This is wildly detrimental to mute/deaf user's communication ability.

2. Chat should be able to be re-read in some form be it by the popup/fan menu or by a chatbox tucked in a corner similar to the microphone and gesture toggle icons. The second option is best left to be a toggle to be persistent appearing only when someone chats, or be turned off entirely in events where users are spamming. 

Perhaps even implement an 'auto hide' feature if a pre-set text limit or personal text filter is triggered, while allowing the user to re-check what was said in their menu afterwards.

3.Timestamps should be available as an optional toggle for purposes of world moderation and helping users pay attention to what is said by chat-users when to avoid miscommunication between one another. At the very least allow this feature for world admins.
title: Toggleable Text-Chat History with timestamps.
